background_story: Harmony was a free-spirited bartender with a passion for creating unique cocktails. One summer evening, she experimented with a mixture of peach puree and Prosecco, crafting a drink that would soon become her signature Bellini. As the sun set over the bustling streets of Venice, Harmony's Bellini gained popularity among the locals and tourists alike. Her charming personality and impeccable mixology skills made her a beloved fixture at the bar. On warm afternoons, Harmony would often take a break to sing along to the street performers, her voice blending in perfect harmony with the sounds of the city. As the years passed, her Bellini recipe remained a secret, but its fame spread far and wide, with people coming from all over to taste the drink that had brought Harmony and the city together in perfect harmony.
